# Fidelity Investments

> Fidelity Investments provides comprehensive retirement planning, investment accounts, brokerage services, and wealth management solutions for individuals.

Fidelity Investments is a leading financial services company offering retirement accounts (IRAs, 401(k)s), investment tools, financial planning services, and brokerage platforms. The site helps users plan for retirement, manage investment accounts, and access educational resources on personal finance.

## Key Topics

- 401(k) plans
- Roth IRA
- Traditional IRA
- IRA rollover
- Retirement planning
- Investment accounts
- Financial planning
- Brokerage services
- 529 education savings
- Health Savings Account (HSA)
- ETFs
- Zero-commission trading
- Wealth management
- Inherited IRAs
- 403(b) and 457(b) plans

## Retirement Planning & Accounts

- [Retirement Planning | Preparing For Retirement | Fidelity Investments](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement/retirement-planning): Retirement planning strategies with IRA, 401(k), and rollover options
- [Retirement Accounts | Plan & Save For Retirement | Fidelity Investments](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement/retirement-accounts): Overview of retirement account options: Roth IRA, Traditional IRA, and other savings vehicles
- [401(k) Rollover & IRA Transfer | Simplify Retirement | Fidelity Investments](https://www.fidelity.com/retirement/401k-rollover): Guide to 401(k) rollovers, IRA transfers, and Roth conversions

## Financial Planning & Tools

- [Financial Planning | Get Started With a Free Plan | Fidelity Investments](https://www.fidelity.com/what-we-offer/planning): Free financial planning tool covering retirement and investment accounts
- [Personal Finance and Financial Basics | Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.com/financial-basics/overview): Educational guide to financial basics: budgeting, debt, retirement

## Getting Started

- [Fidelity Investments - Retirement Plans, Investing, Brokerage, Wealth Management, Financial Planning and Advice, Online Trading](https://www.fidelity.com): Fidelity homepage: retirement, investing, brokerage, wealth management
